name: 日付範囲と請求項目を示すBilling History表
prompt: Correct the previous billing-history export by including the full lower border of the visible row. Keep the same ImageGen composition and all source content. Export a crop from the preserved 2095x751 candidate at x=0,y=150,w=2095,h=430; do not scale, repaint, or regenerate. Preserve the original date, item, statement number, four headers, and blank charge/status cells. Keep white surfaces, slate-neutral controls, and the official Lighthouse gradient only on the small title marker. No tint colors, washes, or glow.
reviewNotes: Reviewed corrected crop-only export. Version 2 was marked needs-correction because it trimmed the row lower divider; v3 uses the preserved ImageGen canvas at x=0,y=150,w=2095,h=430 and includes the complete divider. No scaling or repainting. Official gradient stays on the small title marker, surfaces white, controls slate-neutral, no tint. Source values are unchanged; charge and status remain blank. Static visual inspection only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
